description: Stood, and left Gib on the book at home.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Kept her answer for her own table.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat on the thin book and did not move.
name: Gib

description: Ate, and said a page does not walk in the night.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Told them to keep the day and their counsel.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Stood in the south aisle and left the page for home.
name: William Shakespeare
